limitations: The docs-check gate loads the two repository schema files through Test-Json -SchemaFile and runs 1,827 negative instances across all 65 C0/C1/DEL code points, seven fields, four string positions, and U+2028-before-ESC cases, plus ten positive printable, U+2028-only, and empty-label instances.
The validator result is from PowerShell 7.6.4; it confirms the repository gate and JsonSchema.Net behavior in this environment, not every third-party JSON Schema implementation.
This slice covers only AudioSessionDescriptor v1 and CalibrationResponse v1. Other repository schemas with printable-string patterns were not audited or changed by Issue #1151.
Runtime code and DSP behavior are unchanged; no live audio, driver loading, WaveRT, HLK, signing, or release acceptance is implied.
source_commit is the main head at authoring time; under the current provenance convention, a post-squash source_commit repair is still required.
